## Portfolio

These projects were made outside my 9-to-5. I used them to dig deeper into CS concepts that interest me, like:

1. System design
2. Embedded development
3. Applied AI

### 1. wbar.org

In 2024, I made my college's radio station site from the ground-up so that people could listen to the radio stream
online. This included:

- Conducting interviews with WBAR listeners to figure out which features were most impactful
- Designing the database to be scalable
- Building a CI/CD pipeline on GitHub so that updates could be shipped instantaneously

#### Project stack

- React frontend
- Python backend (FastAPI)
- Postgres database
- Deployed on AWS

You can see the site live at https://wbar.org.

### 2. Flight Simulator

I mentioned I'm an electronics hobbyist! I created a custom controller for a home-spun flight simulator using an ESP32
development board and some peripherals (buttons, joysticks, etc.). Technical accomplishments:

- I developed a custom serial protocol for the chip to communicate with the laptop
- Displayed real-time flight feedback through the custom protocol

#### Project stack

- C++ (ESP32 programming)
- C# (Unity programming)

### 3. Privacy Guardian

With this project, I wanted to solve a problem: terms of service for the products we use every day are incredibly dense.
I created Privacy Guardian to summarize terms of service and evaluate them based on a set of configurable red flags, to
help a user answer: "should I accept these terms of service?".

#### Project stack

- React
- FastAPI
